reason: I desperately need maker-checker accountability for ROC filing reviews at 10 PM, but if files live in our Google Drive, an assistant could easily move or delete an entire folder by mistake. Without ironclad protection against staff trashing or misplacing client folders, I cannot trust this with our compliance records.
objection: If files stay in our Google Drive, what happens if an assistant accidentally deletes or moves the folder?
would_change_my_mind: A Drive permission lock or automated snapshot safeguard that makes client folders tamper-proof against accidental moves or deletions by assistants.
